from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u070/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    one = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1)
    two = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2)
    r, c = one
    tr, tc = two
    sr = (tr > r) - (tr < r)
    sc = (tc > c) - (tc < c)
    dr, dc = abs(tr-r), abs(tc-c)
    diagonal_steps = max(0, min(dr, dc) - 1)
    for _ in range(diagonal_steps):
        r += sr
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    if dr > dc:
        while abs(tr-r) > 1:
            r += sr
            out[r][c] = 3
    elif dc > dr:
        while abs(tc-c) > 1:
            c += sc
            out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-a43b2993.py'
path.write_text(code)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_a43b2993',path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

out1=[[0]*12 for _ in range(13)]; out1[3][11]=2; out1[10][1]=1

out2=[[0]*12 for _ in range(15)]; out2[1][1]=2; out2[13][8]=1
for r,c in [(2,2),(3,2),(4,2),(5,2),(6,2),(7,2),(8,3),(9,4),(10,5),(11,6),(12,7)]:out2[r][c]=3
assert mod.transform(in1)==out1
assert mod.transform(in2)==out2
test=[[0]*16 for _ in range(16)]; test[1][4]=1; test[13][12]=2
res=mod.transform(test)
